Trigger A creature within 30 feet of you takes a hostile action against you or your allies.

Frequency Once per day

When you have no other options, you trust your chances to the simplest determinant you have. You flip a coin. Alternatively, you can do a special Card Draw and Play for this reaction which does not interact with or trigger any other feature. You treat a suit number of 1-3 for Tails and a suit’s number of 4-6 as Heads. You cannot use Sleights, Fortune, or Misfortune effects on this coin toss.

If the coin lands on Heads, you disrupt the action if the creature is of your level or lower as fate erases the act from happening. Otherwise, you make a counteract check with your spellcasting modifier. If the action is a spell or has a defined rank you use the spell rank or effect rank as the rank to counteract against, otherwise you use half the creature’s level rounded up. On a success, you disrupt the action.

If the coin lands on Tails, if the hostile action is targeting you it is automatically a critical success against you or you automatically critically fail the saving throw. Regardless, you also @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.arhOfryj6gDtqwZO]{Effect: Bust!} after resolving the action’s outcomes.
